title: Pokeep — Pokémon GO Local iPhone Collection Scanner & Safety-Gated Transfer Assistant
resourceType: Local-first Next.js / SQLite app, iPhone Use USB automation, Apple Vision OCR, OpenAI vision-assisted collection analysis
purpose: 在 Mac 本機的網頁操作介面中，透過 iPhone Use 及 USB 控制 iPhone，分段擷取 Pokémon GO 寶可夢盒子、能力與評價畫面；使用 Apple Vision 本機 OCR、像素 IV 量測與必要裁圖的 AI 視覺核對，結合 PvPoke、Game Master PvE、養成資源、進化／收藏規則，分析值得保留或可放生的寶可夢。提供暫停／續掃、人工核對、證據截圖，以及經使用者勾選及多重安全確認後才嘗試批次放生。
recommendation: 適合作為本機優先的『裝置 UI 擷取 → 本機文字/像素辨識 → 少量 AI 校對 → 結構化評估 → 人工確認 → 不可逆操作安全閘門』案例，用來研究高風險自動化的授權、身分再驗證、確認點與停止策略。實際用於 Pokémon GO 存在第三方自動操作的服務條款與停權風險；建議先研究架構與模擬測試，不要把示範流程當作官方授權的遊戲自動化工具。
notes: 2026-10-27 已直接核對 GitHub master README.md、package.json、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md、src/lib/iphone-safety.ts、iphone-transfer.ts、openai-config.ts，並查看 tests/iphone.test.ts、tests/core.test.ts 的測試案例名稱；未執行任何測試，不能聲稱通過。Repo 無根目錄 LICENSE，package.json private:true 不等於發佈授權，作者未明確對整體原始碼提供 MIT/Apache 等授權；THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md 內的 MIT 只屬 PvPoke，遊戲資料、素材與商標另受權利人保護。Mac Node.js 24 LTS、USB iPhone、Apple 開發團隊／Xcode WDA、Python 3.9+、iPhone Use 依賴，以及 OpenAI API Key 或相容 Responses API（圖片及 JSON 格式輸出）為官方條件；API 按實際使用量另計，與 ChatGPT 訂閱無關。使用 SQLite 儲存於未版控 .data/，官方聲稱僅把必要裁切圖送 AI 且 store:false；仍應視 API Provider 及畫面可能含非預期資訊而檢查資料安全，store:false 不保證所有服務端沒有其他留存。PvP 評級來源 PvPoke；PvE 用 Game Master 簡化 DPS，不是完整團體戰模擬；稀有或不明狀態不可自動放生，作者實作了人工確認、前景 App 檢查、搜尋結果唯一 CP 校驗、操作前 durable journal 及結果不明暫停而不重送。掃描和放生仍依賴可變的 iPhone UI，OCR 與座標可能錯配，放生通常不可復原。Pokémon GO 官方遊戲公平政策可能將第三方自動控制、bots 或未授權軟體視為違規，可停權或永久封禁；這不是官方 Pokémon GO 工具。沒有登入、連結設備、使用 API Key、安裝 iPhone Use、執行程式、測試辨識或觸發放生。Repo main branch 不是預設，此原始 Repo default branch 為 master。

architecture.provenance: Source repository README and actual source files reviewed read-only on 2026-10-27.
architecture.flow: Mac local Next.js UI + SQLite → USB iPhone Use / WDA screen capture → Apple Vision OCR and pixel IV measurement → selected crops to OpenAI Responses-compatible image model → cross-check & structured collection assessment (PvPoke and Game Master) → human review / protected exclusions → unique target & CP recheck / non-retry safety-gated batch transfer

components.name: Device adapter
components.responsibility: iPhone Use controls an actual USB-connected iPhone with Xcode-signed WDA; screenshots and navigation depend on foreground Pokémon GO portrait UI.

components.name: Local evidence
components.responsibility: Apple Vision OCR, cropped screenshot evidence, deterministic pixel IV measurement and local .data/ SQLite state / checkpoints.

components.name: AI corroboration
components.responsibility: Optional configured OpenAI-compatible vision model verifies only necessary cropped portions; API is external and billed separately.

components.name: Rule-driven decision
components.responsibility: Evaluate combat role, PvP IV ranking, simplified raid DPS, evolution/candy/dust cost, move TM, shiny/costume/legendary/unique collection priorities.

components.name: Human-in-the-loop
components.responsibility: Keep uncertain, locked, special, incomplete or conflict observations out of automatic transfer. Require explicit user selection for transfer candidates.

components.name: Single execution boundary
components.responsibility: Recheck Pokémon identity and uniqueness on phone immediately before transfer; use durable sent journal, stop batch when result is uncertain, never blindly retry.

architecture.irreversibleActionGate: Transferring a Pokémon is generally irreversible; safe protocol must not infer authorization from an AI label alone. The repo offers multiple safeguards, but actual failure rates have not been measured.
architecture.status: Documented implementation with unexecuted source review; real hardware, account safety and gameplay policy compliance not validated.
